_doc: One entry per run family shown on the hub page (scripts/build_research_page.py). Add a new iteration as a NEW entry with its own arch/<id>.md snapshot; never edit a finished iteration's runs or arch file unless explicitly replacing it. `slot` pins the family's chart colour (1-8); give a new family the next unused slot so existing lines keep their colour.

baselines.label: GoWU Phase I (ours)
baselines.about: Our GoWU reproduction, paper v4 defaults, restores emulator states. Best trajectory found so far (not a deployable policy). Seeds 8/9 were stopped at 100M by the campaign's early-stop rule.

baselines.label: GoWU Phase I + trap fix
baselines.change: Not in the paper: a winner confined to one room at the same R for 200 iterations marks those cells as dead states (room-8 rope-post trap).
baselines.verdict: Fix fired once per seed in level-2 room 8 and both seeds escaped: level 3 reached at 213M / 134M (baseline: stuck at 34,200 / 39,200). ~71-72k when they first reached level 3's treasure room (302M / 252M); after that a treasure-room jewel loop (+1000 repeated, score wraps at 1,000,000) runs best R to the 999,100 cap. Everything above ~72k is the loop, not progress.

paper.label: GoWU Phase I (paper, Fig. 6 / Table 2)
paper.note: 50M/100M/200M are midpoints of ranges read off Fig. 6 (20-30k, 45-60k, 75-85k); 400M is Table 2's mean over 100 seeds.

iterations.label: LR v1 · room landmarks
iterations.change: First implementation. Plan default: one landmark per (level, room).
iterations.verdict: π_R learns to fetch the key, but one landmark per room gives no foothold past it. Stuck at 100.

iterations.label: LR v1 · cell landmarks
iterations.verdict: Reachability-gate bug excluded every key landmark after 32 early failures; everything explored from the start. Stuck at 100.

iterations.label: LR v2 · gate fix
iterations.change: Gate spares landmarks with demos; ineligible goals fall back to the nearest eligible ancestor; doomed gate needs 16 handoffs.
iterations.verdict: 6 rooms, 2,500 by ~35M frames and a robust policy (eval mean 2,350-2,500), then flat for 80M frames: 90% of frames go to return trips and random bursts can't clear the next room.
